# Northwind Exercises — Part 3

1. Create a report that shows the name of customers who bought all products purchased by the customer whose identifier is ‘LAZYK’.
2. Create a report that shows the average price of products by category.
3. Create a report that shows the identifier and the name of the companies that provide more than 3 products.
4. Create a report that shows the identifier, name, and total sales of employees, ordered by the employee identifier for employees who have sold more than 70 different products.
5. Create a report that shows the names of employees who sell the products of more than 7 suppliers.
6. Create a report that shows the customer name and the product name such that the quantity of this product bought by the customer in a single order is more than 5 times the average quantity of this product bought in a single order among all clients.
7. Create a report that shows our total revenues in 1997.
8. Create a report that shows the total amount each customer has payed us so far.
9. Create a report that shows the 10 top selling products.
